scope: Selected same-version LibreCAD system-codec DXF raster source capture, not general DXF or DWG parity

policy.memoryQualification: Logical retained raster-source charge, not a bound on total process memory; root and group capture remain individually bounded.

locallyGeneratedEvidence.independentChecks: Matching image and definition fields, clipping paths, dictionary and model owners, reactor identities and definition back-references; both audits clean.
locallyGeneratedEvidence.provenance: Generated locally from scratch; scratch DXF files were not committed.

focusedChecks.name: Image source file-size guard
focusedChecks.details: Exact 512 KiB accepted; 512 KiB + 1 refused with destination unchanged; same-filter corrected retries; 512 distinct definitions refused by retained-source checks; mixed larger raster/material refused and retry succeeds.

limits: 512 distinct IMAGEDEFs are not admitted by this control.
Input files over 512 KiB, mixed raster/material files over 256 KiB, and graphs exceeding existing source budgets remain refused.
No native GUI, Linux/Windows or other version qualification is inferred from this slice.
Hosted CI for the new LibreCAD head remains pending.
